headline.title: India’s app market is booming — but global platforms are capturing most of the gains
headline.summary: India's app market is experiencing significant growth, particularly in non-gaming sectors like streaming and AI. However, global platforms are capturing the majority of the financial gains, despite Indian users spending less per capita compared to their counterparts worldwide.

articles.title: Tesla just increased its spending plan to $25B — here’s where the money is going
articles.summary: Tesla has increased its capital expenditure plan to $25 billion for 2026, which is three times its historical spending levels. The company's CFO indicated that this increase will result in negative free cash flow for the remainder of the year.

articles.title: How SpaceX preempted a $2B fundraise with a $60B buyout offer
articles.summary: SpaceX has disrupted Cursor's plans for a $2 billion funding round by proposing a $10 billion "collaboration fee" and a potential $60 billion acquisition. As a result, Cursor has decided to suspend its fundraising discussions.

articles.title: Formally Verified Patent Analysis via Dependent Type Theory: Machine-Checkable Certificates from a Hybrid AI + Lean 4 Pipeline
articles.summary: A new framework for patent analysis has been developed using a hybrid AI and Lean 4 pipeline, which provides formally verified, machine-checkable certificates. The system includes analyses for freedom-to-operate, claim-construction sensitivity, and cross-claim consistency, enhancing the reliability of patent evaluations.

articles.title: Towards Energy Impact on AI-Powered 6G IoT Networks: Centralized vs. Decentralized
articles.summary: The article examines the energy consumption challenges associated with AI-powered 6G IoT networks, focusing on the impact of centralized versus decentralized approaches. It highlights the importance of optimizing model training and data transmission to enhance energy efficiency in sustainable system design.

articles.title: DT2IT-MRM: Debiased Preference Construction and Iterative Training for Multimodal Reward Modeling
articles.summary: The article presents DT2IT-MRM, a new approach for debiasing preference construction and iterative training in multimodal reward modeling (MRM) to enhance the alignment of Multimodal Large Language Models with human preferences. It addresses challenges in current preference datasets, including granularity, textual style bias, and unreliable signals, aiming to improve the quality of multimodal preference data.

articles.title: Thermal Anomaly Detection using Physics Aware Neuromorphic Networks: Comparison between Raw and L1C Sentinel-2 Data
articles.summary: The article discusses a study on thermal anomaly detection using physics-aware neuromorphic networks, comparing the effectiveness of raw Level-0 (L0) sensor data to Level-1C (L1C) Sentinel-2 data. The findings highlight the challenges of directly utilizing raw data for timely detection of environmental hazards like bushfires and volcanic eruptions, emphasizing the need for efficient early warning systems.

articles.title: OmniMouse: Scaling properties of multi-modal, multi-task Brain Models on 150B Neural Tokens
articles.summary: Researchers have developed the OmniMouse model, which utilizes a dataset of 3.1 million neurons from the visual cortex of 73 mice to explore the scaling properties of brain activity modeling. The study, which encompasses over 150 billion neural tokens, aims to determine whether principles of scaling in AI can be applied to understanding brain function during various stimuli and behaviors.

articles.title: $R^2$-dLLM: Accelerating Diffusion Large Language Models via Spatio-Temporal Redundancy Reduction
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced $R^2$-dLLM, a method aimed at reducing inference latency in Diffusion Large Language Models (dLLMs) by addressing spatio-temporal redundancy in the decoding process. The study highlights that eliminating recurring inefficiencies can enhance the practical deployment of dLLMs for parallel token prediction.

articles.title: S2MAM: Semi-supervised Meta Additive Model for Robust Estimation and Variable Selection
articles.summary: The article introduces S2MAM, a Semi-supervised Meta Additive Model designed for robust estimation and variable selection in machine learning. It emphasizes the integration of manifold regularization to enhance learning from both labeled and unlabeled data by leveraging the geometric structure of Riemannian manifolds.

articles.title: PLaMo 2.1-VL Technical Report
articles.summary: The PLaMo 2.1-VL is a lightweight Vision Language Model designed for autonomous devices, available in 8B and 2B variants, and optimized for local and edge deployment with Japanese-language support. Its primary applications include Visual Question Answering and Visual Grounding, specifically for factory task analysis and infrastructure anomaly detection.

articles.title: M$^{2}$GRPO: Mamba-based Multi-Agent Group Relative Policy Optimization for Biomimetic Underwater Robots Pursuit
articles.summary: The article introduces M$^{2}$GRPO, a new framework for improving cooperative pursuit in biomimetic underwater robots by addressing challenges such as long-horizon decision making and inter-robot coordination. This framework combines a selective state-space Mamba policy with group relative policy optimization to enhance expressiveness and stability in multi-agent systems.
